news.title: Blackhawks star Connor Bedard awaiting test results on injured shoulder
news.ruTitle: Blackhawks star Connor Bedard awaiting test results on injured shoulder
news.description: Connor Bedard will undergo further imaging and consultation on his injured shoulder to determine a course of action, with sources telling ESPN that the Blackhawks captain may have a choice on whether surgery is needed and the timing.
